turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm wrestling with this MCP stdio tool. The tracing context is getting lost when the subprocess starts. What's the recommended pattern to fix that?
For MCP stdio subprocesses, you should read TRACEPARENT on import (startup). This ensures the spans are linked correctly right from the beginning.
Got it. So reading TRACEPARENT on import (startup) is the recommended pattern for MCP stdio tool subprocesses to create linked spans. I'll update the entry point.
Exactly. That should resolve the context propagation issue.
Thanks. By the way, did you see the weather for next Tuesday? I'm hoping it stays dry for the BBQ.
The forecast looks promising, mostly sunny with a low chance of rain.
Good to hear. I'll grab some extra charcoal just in case.
